title: Mycelium Leather
description: This mod adds an additional way to get leather and ink without harming (passive) mobs.
body:
## Mycelium Leather
Some essential items, such as **Leather** and **Ink**, can only be obtained by killing (passive) mobs.
This mod offers alternative features and recipes to still access those items without having to sacrifice your little friends.
Most important items & features:
- **Mycelium Leather** (enables to craft all items that require **Leather**)
- **Soot Ink** (enables to craft all items that require **Ink**)

This mod is still in early development with more features on its way:

![Roadmap](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/293f7bddf30164644ebfe6e99ec4757125f21c44.png)

### Recent drop 1.1.0:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/56zwne8TABw" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### Spade
The **Spade** is a new tool that can be used to harvest **Mycelium Patches** aswell as **Grass Patches**.
Using the Spade _(right-click)_ onto a grass or mycelium block gives you the corresponding patch and leaves a dirt block behind.

### Grass & Mycelium Patch
You can use both types of patches onto a dirt block which turns the dirt block back into the corresponding grass or mycelium block.

### Crafting Mycelium Leather
First the harvested **Mycelium Patch** has to be dried via a furnace. The furnace produces **Dried Mycelium Patches** which then can be pressed to **Mycelium Leather** with the use of the **Herbarium Press**.
